{"metadata":{"description":"Q-Q: 面向学术文献的对话式 AI 研究助手。支持多源搜索（PubMed、arXiv、Semantic Sc​​holar、Crossref）、论文卡片去重及带文件夹功能的收藏夹——基于 DeepSeek Harness 构建。","id":"gh:1334279871","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"deepseek-aix","slug":"PHoenixs57/deepseek-aix","topics":["aix","autoresearch","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","paper","research"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Q-Q: 面向学术文献的对话式 AI 研究助手。支持多源搜索（PubMed、arXiv、Semantic Sc​​holar、Crossref）、论文卡片去重及带文件夹功能的收藏夹——基于 DeepS"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" AI 研究助手。支持多源搜索（PubMed、arXiv、Semantic Sc​​holar、Crossref）、论文卡片去重及带文件夹功能的收藏夹——基于 DeepSeek Harness 构建。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# deepseek-aix"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**deepseek-aix** is an AI research assistant for scholarly literature: describe a research topic in "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"conversation, and the agent collects relevant papers through built-in multi-source search (PubMed, a"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rXiv, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, and more), presenting the results as collapsible, bookmarkable pap"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"antic Scholar, Crossref, and more), presenting the results as collapsible, bookmarkable paper cards."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Built as a fork of DeepSeek Harness, deepseek-aix keeps the full agent infrastructure — sessions, to"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ols, subagents, workflows, sandboxed code execution, and the Web GUI — and adds a literature capabil"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ity on top: a multi-source literature-search service, a durable favorites collection with category f"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"olders, and a Web UI that renders search results and bookmarks as first-class cards."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Literature Search"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Conversational research-topic description**: new sessions start in the deepseek-aix research-ass"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"istant mode; describe a topic in natural language (Chinese or English) and the agent searches, dedup"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"licates, and ranks papers.
- **Multi-source search**: simultaneously searches PubMed, Europe PMC, bi"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"oRxiv/medRxiv, Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv via a built-in MCP service.
- **Autom"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"atic deduplication**: cross-round merging of results.
- **Paper cards in chat**: every search result"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" renders as a card with authors, year, venue, abstract, and DOI/PMID/arXiv identifiers.
- **Full-tex"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"t retrieval**: open-access subset available for detailed reading.
- **Right-side literature panel**:"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" auto-expands after each conversation round to show all collected papers from the current session."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Literature Favorites"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Bookmark with folders**: star papers to save them in a durable, per-user collection organized in"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"to category folders.
- **Cross-session persistence**: favorites are stored server-side (`$DSH_HOME/s"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"torages/literature_favorites.json`) and survive across sessions and browsers.
- **Folder management*"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"*: create, rename, delete folders; move papers between folders.
- **Agent tools**: agent can also re"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ad/write favorites via `literature_favorites_add/remove/list/folder_create/folder_rename/folder_dele"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"tes via `literature_favorites_add/remove/list/folder_create/folder_rename/folder_delete/move` tools."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Skin Center"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Multiple themes**: choose from a variety of UI skins including blue-fantasy, dragon-heir, harbor"},{"id":"p12s2","text":", miku, minecraft, qq98, ths, trading, whale-song, xp, and the classic home skin.
- **Live preview**"},{"id":"p12s3","text":": try on skins before applying; instant theme switching.
- **Skin management**: new skins can be ins"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ore applying; instant theme switching.
- **Skin management**: new skins can be installed as plugins."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Aionui Panel (Right-Side Panel)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **File explorer**: browse the workspace directory tree with search.
- **Multi-tab preview**: previ"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ew files (markdown, images, code) in multiple tabs.
- **Drag-and-drop**: drag files from the explore"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"r directly into the conversation input.
- **Workspace-gated**: respects the current workspace root."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### File @-mentions"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **File references**: type `@` in the input bar to reference files from the workspace.
- **Inline f"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ile chips**: selected files appear as chips in the input area."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Underlying Harness Capabilities"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Workspace and file management**: full file system access with sandboxing.
- **Sandboxed code exe"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"cution**: bash and PowerShell with permission controls.
- **Subagents and parallel research**: spawn"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" background agents for multi-task research.
- **Goal auto-continuation**: autonomous progress toward"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" defined goals.
- **Plan mode and task breakdown**: structured planning and execution.
- **Durable s"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"essions, replay, and multi-model configuration**: persistent conversation history and flexible model"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" selection.
